ledger.x: 938: Balhae refugees found Jeongan in Manchuria.
975: the invasion ends without gain for Liao; the page gives no further detail (bridge).
986: the last Balhae successor state ends.

wars.name: Liao invasion of Jeongan
wars.outcome: The Liao invasion of 975 fails; Liao destroys Jeongan in 986 and Balhae remnants by 999.
